production.note: US model years. The F-Type R is split by year range: rear-wheel drive and 550 hp for 2015, all-wheel drive and 550 hp for 2016 to 2020, all-wheel drive and 575 hp for 2021 to 2024. This record is the 550 hp all-wheel-drive car. First: Jaguar's US brochure dated 'June 2015/16MY' lists the R with 550 HP and an 'All Wheel Drive System'. Last: the brochure titled 'JAGUAR F-TYPE 2020' still lists '5.0 LITER V8 SUPERCHARGED (550HP) AWD' (jaguar-us-f-type-brochure-2020); the 575 hp car followed for 2021 (jaguar-f-type-r-2021-2024).

body.note: The brochure gives F-TYPE R weights for both Coupe and Convertible. The R Convertible replaced the V8 S Convertible for 2016 ('The V8 S Roadster is now dead, replaced by a V8 R Roadster', autoguide-f-type-awd-2014). The Convertible keeps the variant name, so it is not a separate record.

drivetrain.note: 'All Wheel Drive System'. AutoGuide: 'For 2016, all V8 F-Types will come standard with AWD, including the V8 R Coupe' (autoguide-f-type-awd-2014). The 2020 brochure: '(550HP) AWD'.

transmission.note: 'QuickShift 8-speed automatic transmission' (torque-converter automatic). No manual on the V8.

powerHp.note: Quote: "550HP" for the F-TYPE R in the brochure dated 'June 2015/16MY'. The same rating in the brochures titled 'JAGUAR F-TYPE 2018' ('Maximum power HP 550', jaguar-us-f-type-brochure-2018), 'JAGUAR F-TYPE 2019' ('MAXIMUM POWER 550HP', jaguar-us-f-type-brochure-2019) and 'JAGUAR F-TYPE 2020' ('MAXIMUM POWER 550HP', jaguar-us-f-type-brochure-2020).

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL. R Coupe, all-wheel drive, 8-speed automatic (the only transmission), 2016 model year. AutoGuide (Mike Schlee, 19 November 2014): "The V8 R Coupe now weighing 3,814 lbs." Jaguar's US brochure filed as 2017 (no model year printed) gives the same: "Weight from lbs" 3,814 for the R Coupe and 3,847 for the R Convertible (jaguar-us-f-type-brochure-2017); the row is labelled 'Weight from', not curb weight. The 2018-2020 brochures' weight tables could not be read (truncated).

provisionalNote: Weight is provisional: 3,814 lb rests on one article (AutoGuide, for the 2016 car) and a Jaguar US brochure that prints no model year and labels the row 'Weight from' rather than curb weight. A dated Jaguar US specification with a curb weight (2016-2020), or a major magazine's spec panel, would replace it.
